2026-07-28 15:58:45.918638 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918652 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918656 | controller |
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918660 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918664 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918668 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918672 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-28 15:58:45.918681 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
